title: Femoral Vein Cannulation Protocol
author: Jennifer Rutkowsky
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zavf2e6
materials: Using hooks or retractors, keep the incision open.

steps.title: Administer Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Administer Ketamine/Xylazine anesthesia i.p. to ensure the animal is under a deep anesthetic plane.

substeps.instruction: Give initial dose of 90/10 mg/kg.
Administer subsequent doses of 22.5/2.5 mg/kg every 30-45min, starting 1 hour after the initial dose.

steps.title: Prepare Incision Sites
steps.instruction: Prepare the animal's skin for surgery.

substeps.instruction: Shave body hair from all intended incision sites.
Surgically scrub the incision sites.

steps.title: Position Animal and Establish Field
steps.instruction: Position the animal and prepare the surgical area, maintaining tissue hydration with 0.9% sodium chloride (saline) irrigations as needed.

substeps.instruction: Place animal in supine position on the surgery table with the head away from the surgeon.
Provide supplemental warmth using a heatpad.
Loosely tape the tail and hindlimbs to the table.
Establish a sterile surgical field on the left side of the animal (surgeon's right) and apply sterile draping material.

steps.title: Expose Femoral Vein
steps.instruction: Perform blunt dissection to locate and isolate the femoral vein in the groin area.

substeps.instruction: Make a 0.5 cm incision parallel to the femoral vein between the abdomen and thigh using small surgical scissors.
Gently open the incision further via blunt dissection using scissors to reveal vasculature.
Use hooks or retractors to keep the incision open.
Locate the femoral vein (running parallel to the thigh with a perpendicular branch forming a T-shape) and isolate it using fine tip forceps through blunt dissection.

steps.title: Ligate Vein
steps.instruction: Secure the vein and its branch using surgical thread.

substeps.instruction: Use curved forceps to hook the vein and lift it at a 45 degree angle from the left side.
Tie off the vein on the right side with surgical thread.
Tie off the branching part of the vein (the bottom of the T-shape) with surgical thread.

steps.title: Cannulate Femoral Vein
steps.instruction: Insert P-10 tubing into the vein to establish cannulation.

substeps.instruction: Momentarily clip off the left side of the vein using a clip until blood bubbles up.
Prime P-10 tubing (attached to a 0.5ml insulin syringe) with 1:1000 heparin saline solution at the tip and saline in the remainder.
Cut a small incision into the vein using spring scissors and insert the P-10 tubing.
Remove the clip and advance the cannula further into the vein.

steps.title: Verify Cannulation
steps.instruction: Confirm the cannula is correctly placed and there is no leakage.

substeps.instruction: Push the heparin solution in.
Wait 2-3 seconds and pull back on the syringe to ensure blood enters the tubing.
Verify there is no bleeding.
